definitions: Active incidents exclude ENDED; active clusters exclude CONTROLLED
Active investigations exclude COMPLETED and CANCELLED; recurrence counts are recorded RECURRENT clusters per issue, including history
open_clusters aliases active_clusters; neither counts CONTROLLED clusters
Pending approvals have native PENDING status
Completed work is independent of latest evidence-backed RESOLUTION_VERIFIED outcome
limitations: Current projection, not a historical snapshot; intervening writes can change later pages
Bounded search; no result does not establish global absence
